title: Low-Tier CS2 Pick Resolution & Fallback Ladder Architecture

ladder_rungs.name: Prediction Markets (Polymarket CLOB, Kalshi)
ladder_rungs.description: Central limit order book midpoint probability. Requires spread <= 0.12 and non-stale books. Fees excluded.

ladder_rungs.name: Esportsbooks (Thunderpick, Bovada, Pinnacle)
ladder_rungs.description: Two-way moneylines with bookmaker vigorish removed via proportional normalization. Tested against spread ceilings.

ladder_rungs.name: HLTV Identity Research & Alias Disambiguation
ladder_rungs.description: Cross-referencing team rosters, event pages, and sponsor names on HLTV.org to safely match team aliases (e.g. WBT -> WROTBERRY, ROUNDS -> RoundsGG) without guessing.

ladder_rungs.name: Aggregated Reference Lines (EGamersWorld)
ladder_rungs.description: Average of multiple bookmaker quotes for fixtures lacking direct first-party lines. Flat 1.80/1.80 placeholder quotes are rejected.

ladder_rungs.name: Valve Regional Standings Research Model
ladder_rungs.description: Logistic skill model using official Valve CS2 regional points (formula: 1 / (1 + 10^((r2 - r1)*g/400)), RD=75). Uncalibrated research baseline, clearly labeled.

ladder_rungs.name: HLTV Ranking Model / Wide-Book Guidance
ladder_rungs.description: HLTV official top-30 points logistic model or wide-spread bookmaker midpoint labeled strictly as indicative guidance.

ladder_rungs.name: Honest Blank (Unresolved)
ladder_rungs.description: If no reliable evidence exists across all rungs, the match remains unresolved. Never hallucinate or infer numbers.
ladder_rungs.action: Publish full research trail with reason and source links in the dedicated Unresolved register.

unresolved_section_and_limitations.location: Dedicated Unresolved Register section in executive summary (#unresolved-register) and on origination page (origination/#unresolved).
unresolved_section_and_limitations.transparency: When 0 matches are unresolved in the complete list, an explicit confirmation is displayed. When matches are unresolved, each card details the exact missing evidence, stages attempted, and source links.
unresolved_section_and_limitations.limitations_callout: Lists model assumptions (RD=75, uncalibrated), lack of map veto/stand-in adjustments, and non-guaranteed outcome caveats.
